results.desc: arith side effect flips posix; fn shadows special builtin
results.script: eval(){ echo FN; }; A=$((POSIXLY_CORRECT=1)) eval "echo BUILTIN-PATH"

results.desc: := side effect flips posix; fn shadows special builtin
results.script: unset POSIXLY_CORRECT; eval(){ echo FN; }; A=${POSIXLY_CORRECT:=1} eval "echo BUILTIN-PATH"

results.desc: name-level POSIXLY_CORRECT prefix (shipped-correct control)
results.script: eval(){ echo FN; }; POSIXLY_CORRECT=1 eval "echo BUILTIN-PATH"

results.desc: no side effect at all (control: function must win)
results.script: eval(){ echo FN; }; A=1 eval "echo BUILTIN-PATH"

results.desc: arith with NO posix write (control: function must win)
results.script: eval(){ echo FN; }; A=$((Q=1)) eval "echo BUILTIN-PATH"

results.desc: arith plain assign
results.script: eval(){ echo FN; }; A=$((POSIXLY_CORRECT=1)) eval "echo B"

results.desc: arith += onto unset
results.script: eval(){ echo FN; }; A=$((POSIXLY_CORRECT+=1)) eval "echo B"

results.desc: arith postincrement
results.script: eval(){ echo FN; }; A=$((POSIXLY_CORRECT++)) eval "echo B"

results.desc: := store nonempty
results.script: unset POSIXLY_CORRECT; eval(){ echo FN; }; A=${POSIXLY_CORRECT:=1} eval "echo B"

results.desc: := store EMPTY value (name-level says any value counts)
results.script: unset POSIXLY_CORRECT; eval(){ echo FN; }; A=${POSIXLY_CORRECT:=} eval "echo B"

results.desc: = store (unset-only) on unset var
results.script: unset POSIXLY_CORRECT; eval(){ echo FN; }; A=${POSIXLY_CORRECT=1} eval "echo B"

results.desc: command substitution doing the write (SUBSHELL - must NOT flip)
results.script: unset POSIXLY_CORRECT; eval(){ echo FN; }; A=$(POSIXLY_CORRECT=1; echo x) eval "echo B"

results.desc: command substitution + export (still a subshell)
results.script: unset POSIXLY_CORRECT; eval(){ echo FN; }; A=$(export POSIXLY_CORRECT=1; echo x) eval "echo B"

results.desc: nested: := whose default runs an arith write
results.script: unset POSIXLY_CORRECT Z; eval(){ echo FN; }; A=${Z:=$((POSIXLY_CORRECT=1))} eval "echo B"

results.desc: arith side effect in the FIRST of several prefixes
results.script: eval(){ echo FN; }; A=$((POSIXLY_CORRECT=1)) B=2 C=3 eval "echo B"

results.desc: arith side effect in the LAST of several prefixes
results.script: eval(){ echo FN; }; B=2 C=3 A=$((POSIXLY_CORRECT=1)) eval "echo B"

results.desc: arith side effect in the MIDDLE of several prefixes
results.script: eval(){ echo FN; }; B=2 A=$((POSIXLY_CORRECT=1)) C=3 eval "echo B"

results.desc: side effect inside array-subscript arithmetic
results.script: unset arr; eval(){ echo FN; }; arr[$((POSIXLY_CORRECT=1))]=v eval "echo B"

results.desc: ${var:?} / ${var+alt} - no store, must NOT flip
results.script: unset POSIXLY_CORRECT; eval(){ echo FN; }; A=${POSIXLY_CORRECT+set} eval "echo B"

results.desc: does the arith POSIXLY_CORRECT write persist after the command?
results.script: unset POSIXLY_CORRECT; eval(){ echo FN; }; A=$((POSIXLY_CORRECT=1)) eval ":"; echo "pc=[${POSIXLY_CORRECT-UNSET}]"

results.desc: does the posix OPTION persist after the command?
results.script: unset POSIXLY_CORRECT; eval(){ echo FN; }; A=$((POSIXLY_CORRECT=1)) eval ":"; shopt -qo posix && echo posix-ON || echo posix-OFF

results.desc: does the := store persist after the command?
results.script: unset POSIXLY_CORRECT; eval(){ echo FN; }; A=${POSIXLY_CORRECT:=1} eval ":"; echo "pc=[${POSIXLY_CORRECT-UNSET}]"

results.desc: does the PREFIX var A persist? (special builtin in posix mode)
results.script: unset POSIXLY_CORRECT A; eval(){ echo FN; }; A=$((POSIXLY_CORRECT=1)) eval ":"; echo "A=[${A-UNSET}]"

results.desc: baseline: shopt -qo posix reporting works at all
results.script: shopt -qo posix && echo posix-ON || echo posix-OFF; set -o posix; shopt -qo posix && echo posix-ON || echo posix-OFF

results.desc: prefix persistence after special builtin, posix pre-set (R3 family)
results.script: set -o posix; unset A; A=v eval ":"; echo "A=[${A-UNSET}]"

results.desc: prefix persistence after special builtin, NOT posix
results.script: unset A; A=v eval ":"; echo "A=[${A-UNSET}]"
